profile.name: Dressler CESAR 1312 射频电源
profile.description: 这是一台可控射频电源/射频发生器，用于向实验装置或其他射频负载提供稳定的射频功率。设备支持设定输出功率、切换控制与调节模式，并可监测反射功率，以帮助评估负载匹配和运行状态。
profile.description_en: This is a controllable RF power supply / RF generator used to deliver stable radio-frequency power to laboratory equipment or other RF loads. It supports setting output power, selecting control and regulation modes, and monitoring reflected power to help assess load matching and operating condition.
